set.body:
Create the executable acceptance scenario for the complete epic.

Fixture:
- At least two subjects, multiple runs, normalized BOLD NIfTI data, JSON TR metadata, events, fMRIPrep-style confounds, masks, and group covariates.
- Include one compressed input path to exercise staging and enough spatial blocks to expose ordering and merge defects.

Assertions:
- BIDS discovery and preflight produce the expected typed StudyCatalog and FirstLevelUnit layout.
- First-level HRF and design construction, regression, T or F contrasts, named NIfTI output, first-level catalog, group analysis, and second-level output complete end to end.
- Sequential, bounded-parallel, and dense reference results agree within stated numerical tolerances.
- Exact geometry, unit ordering, coefficient inference scope, contrast identity, provenance, and lineage survive every boundary.
- Failure after partial completion resumes from receipts, reuses committed artifacts, and leaves no partial finalized manifest.
- An allocation or instrumentation guard demonstrates supported execution payload memory grows with configured block size rather than total study voxels.
- The scenario follows the repository scenario contract and is clean on required JVM and Scala.js suites, with JVM-only IO assertions isolated appropriately.
set.title: Workflow acceptance: prove fMRIPrep-to-group parity, bounded memory, and resume
